summary: Layer 1B expands the underfollowed universe around AI data-center physical infrastructure. The strongest directly evidenced small/mid-cap discovery candidate is Powell Industries, where official 2026 disclosures show record backlog and a post-quarter data-center order above $400 million. AAON is a cooling-infrastructure candidate with official evidence of BASX data-center cooling demand and record backlog. nVent is larger and increasingly recognized, but remains useful as a narrow electrical-connection/protection and liquid-cooling component supplier rather than a generic AI name. AEP is included as a regulated-asset reference/discovery bridge: it is not small-cap, but its utility territory and large-load commitments make it a demand-anchor and interconnection-cost pass-through monitor for the node. No trading recommendation is implied.
